| Agent | To Do →"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" In Progress | Confirm pickup, start work |

| Agent | Done → In Progress | Reopen when the human replies on a finished item"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" |
| Agent | In Progress → Done | Self-evaluated completion — only when confirmation is OFF |
| Huma"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"n | Review → Done / In Progress | Accept / rework |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The host plugin enforces all of this in the `kanbanflow_move_item` tool — agents never move items in"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"to To Do, never complete from Review, and illegal moves are rejected with an explanation."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Replying in the item's task session while it is in Review sends the agent back to work: it acknowled"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ges, moves the item Review → In Progress and addresses the feedback in the same turn."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**Boards live where your work lives**
- One board per workspace, opened in-app on the conversation's"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" **Board** tab — no popups
- A kanban icon next to every workspace in the sidebar; workspace clicks "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"open boards (toggleable back to session expansion in **Settings → Plugins → Kanban Flow**)
- Board v"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"iews poll every 3s, so agent moves appear on the board while you watch"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**One agent session per item**
- Pickup creates a task session named `CODE-12 · Item name` — click a"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" card to jump straight into it

- **Hover a card for the agent's lat"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"est status**: agents set a short status note (`kanbanflow_set_status`) at the end of every turn — wh"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"at's done, what's next or what they need from you. It appears in a tooltip on hover (and in the item"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" dialog); cards without a status yet show no tooltip
- Session-less workspaces aren't left out: thei"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"r board pins into the current conversation's Board tab (header shows the board's code and workspace)"},{"id":"p17s8","text":" and goes native once that workspace gets its own conversation"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Yours to tune**
- **Board code** per workspace (2–6 chars): item ids like `API-3`, `DKF-17`; exist"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ing ids stay stable when you change it
- **Require confirmation to complete work** (per board, gear "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"menu): when on, the agent can never reach Done — you complete by dragging Review → Done
